title: humanizer is a free doc that makes Claude write like a human
description:
Humanizer: https://github.com/blader/humanizer

People can spot AI writing in one line.

They just can't always explain how.

It's the same tells every time.

Em-dashes everywhere. Three-item lists.

"It's not just X, it's Y."

Words nobody says out loud.

Telling AI to "sound human" does nothing.

It doesn't know what it's doing wrong.

humanizer gives it the actual list.

One document. Free.

Built off Wikipedia's list of AI writing tells.

So it's catching the specific patterns.

And it passes over your text twice.

Once to rewrite it.

Once to check it didn't invent anything.

Like an editor with a proofreader behind them.

Nothing slips through on either pass.

Your writing stops announcing itself.

#humanizer #claude #aiwriting #copywriting #github
